incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: billing-metering anomaly - token emit variance > 9% (eu1-prod). auto-paged oncall-sre
oncall-sre: Ack. looking. tagging @billing-eng @ops-lead
maya: seeing a sustained +11% in token counts for 03:05-03:25 UTC window. Many late emits in kafka topic billing-emit.
arjun: logs show `batch_flush_delay_ms` spiked to 4.2s after deploy. related to batching-window=60->120 change?
billing-eng: yep that rollout went out at 03:00. tentative hypothesis: doubling batching window caused duplicate prefix aggregation at emitter, counts inflated when delayed flush applied.
ops-lead: immediate mitigation: revert batching change to previous commit 4f2a9b. @oncall-sre can you coordinate a quick canary rollback?
oncall-sre: running rollback now -> `deploy rollback --service=billing-emitter --to=4f2a9b` 
incident-bot: Deploy triggered by oncall-sre at 1713812400. status: in-progress.
account-sre: customers: two high-usage tenants got overage emails. paused overage alerts to avoid noisy notifications -> `billing:overage:mute tenant_ids=[T-482, T-993] by ops-lead`
product-md: @account-sre thanks. we should capture list for follow-up credits if needed. any live customer-impact metrics?
maya: quick query: `SELECT tenant_id, tokens FROM emit where ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10T03:00:00Z' and '2026-03-10T03:30:00Z' ORDER BY tokens DESC LIMIT 10;` shows big deltas for T-482 and T-993
arjun: after rollback completed (1713812520) emitter flush rates normalized. starting backfill for delayed window to re-assign tokens correctly.
billing-eng: backfill plan: run dedupe and rewindow tools, then reconcile shadow counts to ledger. kickoff: `./tools/reconcile --from=03:00 --to=03:30 --mode=replace` 
ops-lead: set task priority P1. ETA for backfill full reconcile ~ 45m. will post progress in thread.
incident-bot: BACKFILL job started 1713812700 job_id=bfb-17138 status=running
maya: monitoring: expected billing delta should fall back to baseline after reconcile. alert thresholds temporarily widened to avoid flapping.
product-md: customer comms draft: "We experienced a billing telemetry anomaly that may have triggered transient overage alerts. We're muting alerts and reconciling; we'll follow up with a report and remediation credits if impacted." approved :thumbsup:
account-sre: scheduled CS outreach for affected tenants.
oncall-sre: backfill complete 1713813420. reconciliation summary: aggregate token delta -0.9% vs inflated window (i.e., tokens reduced to near-baseline). No new overages after replay.
billing-eng: root cause: accidental config change in rollout that doubled effective aggregation window for the emitter when combined with spool-delay optimization. Fix: pin batching-window per release + add guardrail alert when batch_delay > 2s.
ops-lead: mitigation complete. rolling postmortem to follow. action items: (1) add deployment preflight check for batching params, (2) add automated mute for overage alerts during reconciliation, (3) customer impact review and credits if needed.
oncall-sre: closing pager. monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED 1713813720. incident_id=INC-2026-03010-01
